children: Bank of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) reported stronger revenue, higher ROE and rising fee income driven by disciplined execution, digital transformation and AI—digital sales are 40% of total and AI tools for ~18,000 staff boost RM support—while shifting mix toward small business and cards and issuing covered bonds.
: BNS posted stronger revenue, higher ROE and rising fee income, citing disciplined execution, digital transformation and AI, plus diversification and investments in sales, tech and product bundling.
: BNS expects ~4% mortgage growth this year, ~CAD75–80B renewals in 2027 and ~CAD80B near-term repricing; shifting mix from mortgages toward small business, commercial banking and credit cards.
: BNS issued covered bonds: GBP 1.25bn floating due Mar 2030, GBP 750m 5.125% due Dec 2032 (LSE listing 16 Sep 2026), and SGD 300m 2.175% due Sep 2029.
: BNS Q3: digital sales 40% of total; aiming to raise digital revenue share. Bank rolled out AI tools for ~18,000 staff, boosted RM support, sped software dev and mortgage underwriting.
This is an AI-generated summary and may contain inaccuracies. Please verify any important information with the original sources.

title: Weekly Recap: Higher revenue and ROE and Mortgage repricing and mix shift
